newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil Gerdau firms started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil Gerdau firms started.

text.p: ING Barings said it had initiated coverage of Brazilian steel firms Gerdau SA cog and Metalurgica Gerdau with a buy rating.
- said its June 1998 price targets were set at $25.50 and $68, respectively, implying upsides of 40 percent and 47 percent.

- Analyst Mirela Rappaport said in a report the Gerdau group recently announced the incorporation of the operating activities of its unit Riograndense into Gerdau SA and holding activities into Metalurgica Gerdau.
- Gerdau SA will also incorporate Siderurgica Pains, concentrating the operating activities of the Gerdau group.

- "As a result, Gerdau SA will gain liquidity, look cheaper in terms of valuation, and benefit from further diversification in its product line through the incorporation of the group's specialty steel division," she said.
- ING Barings also said expects Gerdau group to issue ADRs in Gerdau SA.
- Gerdau SA preferred was off 0.91 percent at 21.80 reais at 1045 local/1345 GMT on the Sao Paulo bolsa. No trades were seen on Metalurgica Gerdau stocks.
